evidence.title: 100+ Best System Design Resources for Interview and Learning

name: Best System Design Resources
summary: Curated list of 100+ courses, books, cheat sheets and interview problems for learning system design.
description: A README-only GitHub list of system design resources for interview preparation and learning: online courses (ByteByteGo, Grokking, Educative), books (Designing Data-Intensive Applications, System Design Interview), practice platforms, concept questions (API gateway vs load balancer, caching, sharding, Kafka), classic design problems (URL shortener, rate limiter, WhatsApp, YouTube), cheat sheets, papers and engineering blogs to follow. 4.5k stars, maintained by javabuddy.
contains: 100+ resources: courses, books, platforms, tutorials and papers
interview concept questions (API gateway vs load balancer, JWT vs session, CQRS ...)
classic design problems: URL shortener, WhatsApp, YouTube, rate limiter, parking lot
system design basics: caching strategies, sharding, Kafka, consistent hashing
engineering blogs list (Netflix, Uber, Airbnb, GitHub, Instagram ...)
